observed_pipeline.eligibility: Graph edge must have a positive learner strength; strength=max(accessibility,support), restrained by negative consequence; quarantined/ineligible edges are omitted.
observed_pipeline.distribution: One fixed-point weighted draw over eligible edges. Edge weight is earned strength times a factor based on max endpoint contextual activation; novelty flattening pulls context toward a common prior. Connectivity/degree is not part of landing weight.
observed_pipeline.propagation: Seed both endpoints of the selected directed edge and follow outgoing edges only, bounded by max_depth. Per-path visited nodes prevent cycles.
observed_pipeline.deduplication: Collapse contributions by edge key, retaining strictly greater attenuated pressure; equal-pressure ties retain first BFS encounter.
observed_pipeline.contributor_selection: Sort pressure descending, then distance, edge key, path; retain max_contributors.
observed_pipeline.normalization: Integer fixed-point scaling limits pressure to total_budget; floor rounding may leave a small residual.
observed_pipeline.renderer: Render positive-pressure contributions as abstract relation tendencies and optional endpoint-label facets; deduplicate identical lines and omit raw graph labels/IDs.

observed: Landing probabilities depend on earned strength and endpoint contextual activation, not graph connectivity.
After landing, directed outgoing neighborhood structure affects propagated contributions and payload.

Propagation recursively multiplies the already-attenuated activation by attenuation raised to the absolute next depth, and applies decay each hop; this makes later-hop pressure decline faster than a constant per-edge attenuation.
The same concept vocabulary and learner strengths can yield different landing and payload when edge endpoints are rewired.
observed_vs_inferred.inferred_hypothesis: Global edge sampling followed by outgoing-only local propagation can select a landing with little surrounding structure, particularly where relevant links point into rather than out of its endpoints; depth-exponentiated recursive attenuation may further reduce distant contributions. Synthetic examples demonstrate possibility, not prevalence or behavioral impact.
unresolved: The exact archival/owner rationale for this neighborhood-projection review was not found by Librarian exact-name search across /home/nyx, attachments, and local Git refs.
No claim is made about prevalence or downstream model behavior in real developmental histories.
observed_vs_inferred.design_context: The owner-approved SAA architecture amendment separates developmental weight and contextual relevance, then specifies a seeded weighted landing followed by topology-shaped local activation through learned links. Current implementation follows that broad sequence; this audit records, but does not judge, its outgoing-only traversal and recursively depth-exponentiated attenuation.
